dedupe_keys.name: arrets de bus de montpellier mediterranee metropole

description: Arrêts de bus de Montpellier Méditerranée Métropole is a dataset listed in Hérault Data open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by Montpellier Méditerranée Métropole. Cette données renseigne les arrêts de bus sur le territoire de Montpellier Méditerranée Métropole. Coverage: Hérault. The portal files it under Routes, Transports et Mobilités. Its keywords are Transport, bus. The portal shows 1,122 records. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2025-10-07 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licence Ouverte v2.0 (Etalab). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support public transport network, service and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-www-herault-data-fr-portal.
